label: Seeker launcher (guard)
note: IP-neutral. The seeker launcher a guard carries (a soldier profile with a 'launcher' block: NpcLauncher, src/systems/npc/npc_launcher.gd; the profile's own 'weapon' is set aside for this one). On foot it is the guard's gun: a slow, unguided seeker at you every few seconds (rate, mag 1, reload_time) that bursts where it lands (blast_size, splash_radius, splash_damage). 'vehicle': at your ship or speeder while the guard's side counts it hostile (the troopers' own rule: a ship off the ground in town, anything you ride near an outpost they are fighting), the tube comes up, the lock builds over lock_time while it is within lock_range and in sight (MissileLock, the ship seekers' lock), and a locked seeker goes at its hull every rate seconds at most, turning by turn_rate (a hard turn or a fast ship shakes it) and bursting within proximity m of the hull. 'damage' is a hit on a ship's hull, 'personnel_damage' a hit on a speeder. A lock or a seeker on your ship sounds the cockpit's seeker warning (ShipPilot._seeker_step); a speeder has no warning. look_s: how often it checks its line of sight (one ray).
